standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue-after.npc: ... Wait a minute... you're that adventurer that has been taking on the Colosseum!

If the player has achieved Grand Champion rank:

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue-after.npc: Wow, what are the chances you'd run into a simple farmer like me.
I suppose you might be needing a reliable herb supply if you're planning to continue fighting in the Colosseum?
I'll keep an eye on any herbs you plant here. It's the least I can do for someone like you.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue-after.player: That's a really kind gesture, but aren't you meant to be focusing on growing your own food?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue-after.npc: It's no trouble. The soil around here is very rich, so it won't need much attention at all. I might even get a reward from the palace for helping such a valiant contender!
